messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: cvode in cmdstan 2.9?
parts:
Hi!

I keep hearing and reading on the users list that the released cmdstan 2.9.0 has the cvode solver included. However, when I download the 2.9.0 tar file I see no cvode at all and a find command

find . -iname "integrate_ode_cvode*"

Gives me nothing. Have you ameneded the tar files or where is cvode in any of the released cmdstans?

Sebastian

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] cvode in cmdstan 2.9?
parts:
It's on the develop branch of CmdStan. It was not released with v2.9.0. It'll be released with v2.10.0.


Daniel
